_readme: Known models per agent. Edit freely; the collector reads this file on every refresh.
Live data always comes first: models an agent reports using, and (where the CLI has a list command) models its own CLI lists, are added automatically.

Each entry: name (shown), match (optional extra id prefixes; dots and dashes are equivalent), unavailableOn (plan labels, e.g. Free), removing (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM when a removal is announced), note (free text, not shown).

State rules: used = recent tokens; zero = usable but unused (dimmed, 0); unavailable = the plan can't use it (dimmed, 'unavailable'). If an agent's CLI lists its models, any known model missing from that list is unavailable.

The 'plans' section holds plan and free-tier notes (changeable; edit freely). A note is shown only when the agent's own tool reports a source (a login, a usage command, a models list); notes never invent numbers. freeNote shows when the tool reports a free plan (or, for OpenCode, lists free models);

copilot.freeNote: Free plan: no premium requests; chat and completions each have a monthly limit (shown above).

opencode.freeNote: Free models have a daily request limit that isn't published.
opencode.goNote: Go ($10 a month): 20% per 5 hours, 50% per week, 100% per month. Shown as meters only if a Go key exists and OpenCode reports usage; no local source found yet. OpenCode's docs list these as $12 / $30 / $60 of usage, and the weekly cap is missing from some doc versions - verify.
opencode.cantRead: Can't read: a limit for the free models (none is published). Shown: tokens from your local sessions.

kimi.note: Kimi Code needs Plus or higher: a rolling 5-hour limit, and no weekly limit on new plans (legacy plans have both). Shown only as the windows the login reports; no login or usage command found on this machine.
kimi.cantRead: Can't read: Kimi's quotas, because Kimi isn't signed in. Run `kimi login` and they will show.

kiro.freeNote: Free tier: 50 credits a month; paid tiers run from 1,000 to 10,000 credits.

amp.freeNote: The free tier is in flux: the ad-supported tier was reported paused, and a $10 daily allowance remains for some users. A daily allowance is shown only if Amp reports one.
amp.cantRead: Can't read: a usage limit or remaining allowance. `amp usage` reports a credit balance and dollar costs, which this panel never shows; only its token total is used.
